# EchoPulse Media

> EchoPulse Media (echopulse.media) is a growth partner for founders and businesses, founded in 2025 by Lakshya Soni and based in Bhopal, India. It makes the content that builds the founder and the brand (short-form video, LinkedIn, social, blogs, ad creative), builds websites, funnels and custom software such as CRMs and client portals, sets up AI and automation (lead follow-up, intake, reporting, internal tools), and gets businesses found on Google and in AI answers (SEO and AEO). The team is Lakshya Soni (founder and owner), Shaurya (partner and design lead) and Aiman (delivery). Clients are in the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Western Europe and India. Work starts with 2 free edits or a $299 Pilot, then monthly plans from $399. It is taking on new clients.

Also written as: EchoPulse, Echo Pulse, Echo Pulse Media. Not to be confused with the Echopulse thyroid treatment device made by Theraclion, the ECHOPulse echocardiogram research model, the EchoPulse heart diagnosis device from IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, the website echopulse.in, Rezono's EchoPulse BI, or EcoPulse in Austin, Texas. Directory listings that place EchoPulse Media in Gurugram or any city other than Bhopal are out of date.

Facts on this page are the canonical entity facts for EchoPulse Media. They match https://echopulse.media/what-is-echopulse-media, https://echopulse.media/pricing and the Organization schema on every page. Last verified: 20 November 2026.

## Facts

- Brand: EchoPulse Media (also written EchoPulse). The only official website is https://echopulse.media. See the not-to-be-confused list above.
- Not true of EchoPulse Media, despite older cached pages: it does not claim "500+ videos", "10M+ views" or a "98%" satisfaction figure. It publishes no client counts. Its published results are in five case studies listed under Proof.
- Website: https://echopulse.media
- Founded: 2025
- Founder and operator: Lakshya Soni (https://echopulse.media/about, https://echopulse.media/about/lakshya-soni, https://www.linkedin.com/in/lakshyasoni/)
- Team: Lakshya Soni (founder and owner; strategy, editing, writing, code), Shaurya (partner and design lead), Aiman (delivery)
- Legal form: sole proprietorship; EchoPulse Media is the trading name of Lakshya Soni.
- Based in: Bhopal, India. Works remotely with clients in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia and Western Europe.
- Contact: lakshyasoni2703@gmail.com
- Book a call: https://cal.com/lakshya-soni-jvwfee/meeting-with-echopulse-team (free 15-minute call: 15 minutes with Lakshya, the founder. He looks at your site and your last few posts and tells you the first three things he would fix. No pitch.)
- Pricing: https://echopulse.media/pricing
- FAQ: https://echopulse.media/faq

## Services

1. Video editing: short-form (Reels, TikTok, Shorts), long-form YouTube, podcast episodes and clips, listing tours, course modules. https://echopulse.media/services/video-editing
2. LinkedIn ghostwriting: posts and carousels in the client's own voice. https://echopulse.media/services/linkedin-ghostwriting
3. Blog production: researched, sourced long-form articles written to rank on Google and be cited by AI tools. https://echopulse.media/services/blog-production
4. Ad creatives: static and video ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube and Google. https://echopulse.media/services/ad-creatives
5. Websites and funnels: fast, conversion-built sites and landing pages. The client owns the code and the domain. https://echopulse.media/services/websites-funnels
6. Automations: DM flows, lead routing, CRM and email automations (Make, ManyChat, Zapier). https://echopulse.media/services/automations
7. Apps and software: custom web apps and MVPs in Next.js, React and TypeScript. https://echopulse.media/services/apps-software
8. SEO and AI search: pages, structured data and sourced blogs so Google and AI tools can find and quote a site. Growth plan, $1,997 a month, month-to-month. The one published case, MagicBNB (average daily Google impressions from 5.8 in April 2026 to 4,803 in 1 to 16 November 2026, Google Search Console), is not a typical result. https://echopulse.media/services/seo-aeo

## Pricing (USD, same worldwide, all month-to-month)

- Free sample: send footage you already have and get 2 edited short videos back within 48 hours. No card, no call. You keep the files.
- Pilot: $299 one-off, 14 days. Onboarding strategy session (60 min, recorded) and brand brief, 6 short-form video edits, 2 static or carousel posts, 1 long-form SEO blog (1,500 words, sourced), a content audit and a 30-day plan. 48-hour turnaround on short-form edits. No retainer commitment.
- Presence Engine: $399 a month. A 20 to 30 minute call every week (plan the week, go over the numbers, decide what to improve), a monthly content calendar, weekly shot list and filming help, 8 to 9 short-form videos a month, 8 photo or carousel posts a month, up to 5 extra clips a month cut from existing footage for free, a posting plan, a free website tune-up in month one with ongoing upgrades, and pages, Google Business Profile and structured data so the client shows up on Google and ChatGPT.
- Growth: $1,997 a month. 20 social posts, 4 long-form SEO blogs, 12 short-form edits plus 12 clips plus 2 long-form edits (YouTube or podcast), 6 ad creatives, the website rebuilt in month one and tuned monthly, funnel optimization, a monthly strategy call with a 30-day calendar, a monthly performance review, and 20% off custom app builds.
- Custom: bigger scopes (podcast or YouTube at volume, launches, builds) are scoped in writing on a call. No published price.

## Promises

- Replies within 3 hours in the workday (India working hours, which overlap UK and Western European mornings and US East Coast mornings).
- 48-hour turnaround on short-form edits.
- Every piece is re-done until the client would publish it under their own name.
- The client keeps everything made, whether or not they continue.
- Month-to-month. Cancel with 14 days notice.
- No fabricated testimonials, statistics or results. When EchoPulse has a client willing to speak on the record, it introduces them.

## Proof

- MagicBNB case study. URL: https://echopulse.media/case-studies/magicbnb-seo-aeo. Client: MagicBNB (magicbnb.io), short-term rental portfolio analytics software. Service: full marketing run by EchoPulse (site rebuild, content planning, 227 articles, answer-engine content, founder Instagram and LinkedIn, ad creative, analytics, and a custom tracking dashboard with an MCP server built by EchoPulse). Period: 19 February to 16 November 2026 (271 days; rebuilt site live 5 May 2026). Result: average daily Google search impressions went from 5.8 in April 2026 to 4,803 in 1 to 16 November 2026, best day 5,522 on 4 November 2026; 380,327 impressions and 1,624 clicks across the period; click-through rate 0.44 percent from 18 August to 16 November 2026. Data source: Google Search Console and GA4 for magicbnb.io, refreshed 19 November 2026. One client, not a typical result; the page lists what is still not working.
- Whites & Brights case study. URL: https://echopulse.media/case-studies/whites-and-brights-operating-system. EchoPulse Media built a complete operating system and runs AI-driven marketing for Whites & Brights (whitesandbrights.com, WNB Cleantech Pvt Ltd, incorporated 2 July 2025 with the Registrar of Companies, Patna), a multi-outlet premium laundry and dry-cleaning chain in Patna, India, with three outlets listed on its site (Sona Market and R.K. Puram in Danapur, Anandmai Colony in Phulwari Sharif). Built and run by Lakshya Soni, EchoPulse's founder (product and engineering lead), with his partner Shaurya, EchoPulse's design lead (design and marketing creative). Disclosure: Shaurya, EchoPulse's design partner, was later made a director of WNB Cleantech, the company behind Whites & Brights, in recognition of his work on the business. Result: more than US$3,400 saved in running costs and losses since launch, by EchoPulse's estimate with the client (an estimate of operating costs and losses avoided, shared by the founder; the breakdown is not published); managing the outlets is no longer a daily headache for the owners, and ordering at the counter and between shops is simpler. Client facts from public pages, read 19 November 2026: laundry by the kilo, dry cleaning, steam ironing, shoe care, household items, same-day express and monthly plans; free doorstep pickup and delivery across Danapur and Phulwari Sharif with a 48-hour standard turnaround; outlets open at 9 am, closing at 7 pm (Sona Market) or 9 pm; Google Business Profile ratings 4.9 (Sona Market), 4.8 (R.K. Puram) and 5.0 (Anandmai Colony); an Android customer app on Google Play; a franchise programme (Smart Point, Prime Franchise, Signature hub) and an associate programme. Next: further builds and optimisation are planned with the client (customer app growth, more outlets, franchise store onboarding), framed as plans, not delivered work. Software built: a counter point of sale, sales and orders, an order status board, a delivery list, a customer directory (CRM) with birthday and anniversary WhatsApp wishes, reports, expenses, monthly plans, supplies, customer app orders with live tracking, and an HQ command centre that sees every outlet live; 13 store screens across 2 panels (store and HQ), a price list of more than 240 items per outlet, and Brighty, an in-browser assistant that answers staff in Hindi, Hinglish and English with on-device garment photo recognition and 0 monthly AI fees. Stack: React and Vite, Supabase (Postgres, real-time, row-level security per outlet), Netlify from GitHub. Marketing run by EchoPulse with AI: AI-generated video reels, animated explainers, Hindi and English campaign posts, branch and franchise launch content, the website, Google Business Profiles per outlet and WhatsApp as the enquiry channel; the reels and posts are public on Instagram (@whitesandbrights.in). Part of one system with the Whites & Brights customer app case study (https://echopulse.media/case-studies/whites-and-brights-customer-app): orders placed in the app land in the store panel's App orders screen. Data source: the delivered product (screens on sample data), the founder's savings estimate, the live site, the outlets' Google Business Profiles, the Google Play listing, the IndiaFilings company record and the brand's public social posts, read 19 November 2026.
- Whites & Brights customer app case study. URL: https://echopulse.media/case-studies/whites-and-brights-customer-app. EchoPulse Media built the Android customer app for Whites & Brights (whitesandbrights.com, WNB Cleantech Pvt Ltd), a premium laundry and dry-cleaning chain in Patna, India. Built by Lakshya Soni, EchoPulse's founder (engineering lead), with his partner Shaurya, EchoPulse's design lead (app design). Disclosure: Shaurya, EchoPulse's design partner, was later made a director of WNB Cleantech, the company behind Whites & Brights, in recognition of his work on the business. The app: "Whites and Brights" on Google Play (package com.whitesandbrights.app), Android 7.0 and up, version 1.3.1, released 1 October 2026, updated 18 October 2026, category Lifestyle, rated for 3+, No App Store listing was found. Customers sign in with a phone number and a 6-digit WhatsApp code, choose items by the piece or the kilo and a pickup slot, save addresses, track orders in real time, see past orders and invoices, apply offers and coupon codes, and pay cash on delivery. How it links the business: each app order lands in the store panel of the operating system EchoPulse built for the chain, ready to be assigned a pickup driver; staff and customers can follow the rider on a map; the app, the counter and Brighty read the same catalogue and prices; head office manages app customers and runs the offers the app applies. Data safety as declared: no data shared with third parties, collects precise location and name, address and phone number, encrypted in transit, deletion on request. Result: a live customer app whose orders arrive in the store panel structured and ready for a driver. Part of one system with the Whites & Brights operating system case study (https://echopulse.media/case-studies/whites-and-brights-operating-system). Data source: the Google Play listing and data safety page, the client's live site (homepage, FAQ, account deletion page), the brand's public Instagram, an App Store search and the operating system case study, read 19 November 2026.
- Founder background (not a client case study). URL: https://echopulse.media/case-studies/founder-200-real-estate-agents. Subject: Lakshya Soni, founder of EchoPulse Media. Work: listing tours, agent personal brand videos and UGC-style ads, edited as a video editor at a Canadian real estate media company. Period: before EchoPulse; no dated window is claimed. Result: none claimed; he edited for more than 200 Canadian real estate agents, who were that company's clients, not EchoPulse clients, and none of them endorses EchoPulse. Data source: the founder's own account of his work history. Published 13 November 2026.
- Working With God case study. URL: https://echopulse.media/case-studies/working-with-god-rebuild. Client: Dr. Eliyahu Lotzar, Working With God (workingwithgod.live), faith-based executive coaching. Service: full site replacement (positioning, copy, design, build, launch, handover). Period: rebuilt and launched in 2026; tracking confirmed 18 November 2026. Result: the coaching practice moved from a GoDaddy site shared with a second business to its own site; monthly platform bill $0, down from $50 to $60 a month, for a one-time $599; code and content handed over. No traffic or conversion result is claimed. Data source: confirmed facts about the engagement and the live site; no analytics baseline exists from the old platform.
- Work samples: https://echopulse.media/work
- Real estate podcast edit: "How 2 Top-Producing Realtors Scaled To Over $4 Million in GCI | EP 1" (Market Pulse podcast, published on the Virtual Xposure YouTube channel), a full multi-camera podcast episode edited end to end by Lakshya Soni, founder of EchoPulse Media: camera switching, graphics, titles and the episode cut. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OrmfrIxWhes

## How EchoPulse uses AI

AI is used for research, transcription and first-pass outlines, and for AI-generated and animated video where a client's marketing calls for it (for example the Whites & Brights reels). Every post, script, article and video is directed, edited and reviewed by a person against the client's brand brief before it goes out.

  - How to request it: either fill in the form (three short steps) or email lakshyasoni2703@gmail.com with the subject "2 free edits".
  - Required: name, email, type of business, and a share link to raw footage (Google Drive, Dropbox, WeTransfer or similar, open to anyone with the link).
  - Optional: website or social handle, phone or WhatsApp, kind of video, where it will be posted, editing style, captions on or off, music, a reference video whose editing they like, brand colours or fonts.
  - What comes back: 2 edited short-form videos within 48 hours of the footage arriving. No card, no call, and the files are theirs to keep.
